title: Investigating Bias in Multilingual Language Models: Cross-Lingual Transfer of Debiasing Techniques

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the percentage of instances where the language model prefers (assigns a higher probability to) a stereotypical/biased sentence over a less biased sentence, using multilingual translations and samples of the CrowS-Pairs dataset.
